messages:
alana: Quick heads-up — saw a ~12% p95 token-latency regression on canary after the kernel-selector change :eyes:
alana: It lines up with a jump in kvcache_evictions_total and a drop in kvcache_reuse_by_route for chat-heavy routes.
ryan: ugh. which routes specifically?
maria: looks worst for /chat/conversation and /qa/batch-embed (1.8x evictions vs baseline)
hugo: can you paste the perf trace and the kvcache series?
alana: sharing queries and a screenshot link
alana: PromQL I'm using:
```
sum by(route) (rate(kvcache_evictions_total[5m]))
sum by(route) (rate(kvcache_hit_total[5m])) / sum by(route) (rate(kvcache_lookup_total[5m]))
sum by(route) (kvcache_memory_bytes)
```
ryan: adding token-level latency panels: token_latency_p50, p95, p99 split by kernel_variant and route
ryan: also want a stacked bar for batch_size distribution over time (kernel A vs kernel B)
maria: Perf-bot run profile for a 1h sample? @perf-bot can you attach the flamegraph
perf-bot: Attached flamegraph: https://redwood.internal/perf/graphs/1718454321-flame.svg :white_check_mark:
hugo: flame shows long stalls in kernel A when cache misses spike, batching size dips to 1-2 — looks like allocator is falling back sync
tara: maybe the batching heuristic reduces batch targets when prefix cache miss rate increases per shard
alana: hypothesis: new kernel selector prefers kernel A for short sequences, but when kvcache miss increases the KV lookup penalty plus kernel A scheduling results in overall worse token latency
ryan: can we get a route-by-route reuse heatmap? want to see reuse window vs hit_rate vs evictions
maria: agree. also compare kvcache_reuse_by_route before/after rollout for the same traffic slice
hugo: I'll add an allocator metric to tag "fallback_reason" (e.g., missing_prefix, shard_contention, mem_pressure) so we can correlate
alana: propose concrete steps:
1) dashboard: small panels for evictions (rate), hitrate, mem footprint, reuse_by_route heatmap, batch_size distribution, token_p95_by_kernel
2) alert: route-level evictions spike > 50/min AND token_p95 > 200ms for >5m
3) perf: attach 1h flamegraph and kernel scheduler trace for the moment evictions spike
4) instrumentation: allocator tag for fallback_reason and prefix-miss counter
ryan: I'll draft the Grafana and drop in /dash/eng-runtime/kvcache-alloc-surface. Will include PromQL and annotations for rollout windows
maria: i'll draft the alert rules — want to avoid noisy pages, so add a suppress window for canary traffic tags
hugo: i'll send a small patch to runtime to emit fallback_reason and reuse_window_histogram
tara: can we also log sample request ids for top evicting routes so we can repro locally?
alana: yes, add a sampling policy: log up to 10 reqs/min per route when evictions > threshold
ryan: ok will do dashboard first. tagging folks: @hugo you'll post the allocator metric PR, @maria alerts, @alana will coordinate follow-up meeting
maria: thanks. syncing tomorrow 10am PT to review dash + alerts :calendar: 
ryan: will post the initial panel links when ready :thumbsup:
maria: nice, thanks everyone
